About Mitre Media

Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

About the Role

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and maintain Rails applications (Rails 8)

  • Integrate LLMs into our microservices architecture for state management and real-time user experiences.

  • Enhance front-end experiences with Hotwire, StimulusJS, or React, ensuring seamless AI-driven interactions.

  • Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Required Technical Skills

Back-End

  • Ruby (5+ years, expert-level)

  • Ruby on Rails (Rails 6-8 preferred)

  • PostgreSQL (or MySQL)

  • Elasticsearch

  • Redis

  • Docker

Front-End

  • StimulusJS or JavaScript ES6

  • Tailwind CSS

  • HTML

  • HTTP

AI Integration

  • Experience integrating AI/ML models (e.g., LLMs, NLP) with web applications

  • Familiarity with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Hugging Face) or APIs (e.g., xAI, Anthropic)

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Kubernetes for microservices orchestration

  • React for advanced front-end components

  • Graph databases for complex financial data

  • Contributions to open-source RoR or AI projects

Required Soft Skills

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for AI and FinTech

  • Natural leader who mentors and inspires teammates

  • Problem-solver with a “get things done” mentality

  • Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration

  • Attention to detail, ensuring clean, maintainable code

  • Team player comfortable as an individual contributor

Why Join Us?

  • Impactful Work: Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights.

  • Cutting-Edge Tech: Work with Rails 8, LLMs, and modern tools like Hotwire, Databricks, and xAI’s API in a microservices architecture.

  • Autonomy and Influence: Collaborate directly with our CEO and CTO to shape our AI-driven platform, with freedom to innovate.

  • Competitive Compensation: $160,000–$200,000 CAD/USD (based on experience) and benefits.

  • Remote Flexibility: Remote-first (±3 hours from ET) with hybrid in office collaboration in Toronto or NYC

  • Growth Opportunities: Budget for AI and Rails conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, RailsConf), plus access to cutting-edge AI tools for experimentation.

  • Dynamic Culture: Join a small, no-ego team passionate about trust, innovation, and making a difference in FinTech.

About Mitre Media’s AI-Driven Platform

Mitre Media powers premium financial brands like Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com with the Mitre Platform. This platform integrates traditional content management, financial data, first-party data, ad revenue, and subscription tools, all enhanced by LLMs for rich, user-focused experiences. Our data-derived insights delight users, while our advertising solutions deliver unmatched performance for partners like BlackRock and Vanguard, leveraging advanced targeting and first-party data.

How to Apply

 

Submit your resume, GitHub profile, and a brief note on why you’re excited about building AI-driven FinTech to jobs@mitremedia.com.

Job Overview

Create engaging YouTube tutorials about software, digital marketing, and AI tools that reach millions of people around the world every month through our YouTube channel, Metics Media.

  • Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way.

  • Native-level written and spoken English

About the Role

Our client is a fast-growing AI company building reliable, fair and open infrastructure for AI training data. Their marketplace helps the people who create data get value for it, and gives AI labs trustworthy data to train on. It is already used by startups, Fortune 500 companies and frontier labs, and the company is backed by leading venture investors, including Y Combinator. They are scaling quickly to meet strong demand.

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Privacy and Anonymization to build the systems that make sensitive, real-world data safe and still useful for AI training. You will develop methods to detect and remove personally identifiable information, secrets and other sensitive content from raw data before it enters processing and synthetic data pipelines â protecting privacy without destroying the structure and signal that make the data valuable for training agents.

This is a privacy and data-protection engineering seat, not a synthetic-task design role. You will own the pipeline that stands in front of downstream processing, training, evaluation and synthetic generation.

This is a full-time role, starting ASAP. Offices are in San Francisco and Singapore; remote candidates are welcome if their working hours can overlap about 70â80% with either San Francisco (US Pacific) or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.

What You'll Do

  • Build systems to detect PII, quasi-identifiers, credentials and other sensitive information, and design transformations based on the data type and the downstream use case.

  • Develop and benchmark detection approaches that combine rules, statistical models, classifiers and LLM-based methods.

  • Build production pipelines that anonymize raw data before it enters downstream processing, training, evaluation or synthetic data generation.

  • Create evaluation frameworks that measure privacy risk and retained data utility, including recall-weighted metrics, leakage tests and adversarial re-identification attempts.

  • Design systems that stay robust to new data sources, schema drift, unusual formats and sensitive information embedded in unexpected fields.

  • Work with engineering, research, operations and customers to translate privacy requirements into practical technical policies and safeguards.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong proficiency in Python, and experience building reliable production data or machine-learning systems.

  • Experience with information extraction, named-entity recognition, classification, or related methods for detecting rare or sensitive content.

  • Strong experimental instincts, and the ability to compare approaches across recall, precision, latency, cost and downstream data utility.

  • An understanding of the difference between redaction, masking, pseudonymization, anonymization and synthetic data â and when each is appropriate.

  • High attention to detail, and the ability to reason about subtle leakage paths, edge cases and adversarial failure modes.

  • Experience building data-processing pipelines end to end, including where there was no fully prescribed roadmap.

  • Clear written and spoken English, and comfort collaborating across teams and time zones.

  • Strong candidates may also have hands-on experience with privacy-enhancing technologies (such as differential privacy, k-anonymity, secure aggregation or format-preserving encryption); have worked with sensitive data in healthcare, finance or security; have built low-latency or high-throughput ML inference or data-processing systems; or have taken work from early research through to production.

  • Technical aptitude and learning potential matter more than years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet every point above.

Why This Role Matters for You

  • Make real-world data safe to train on: You will build the systems that let sensitive data be used for AI training without exposing people or secrets.

  • Privacy without wrecking utility: The job is not only to redact, but to keep the structure and signal that downstream training and synthetic pipelines need.

  • From detection to production: You will own the full path: detection methods, transformations, evaluation, and the pipeline that sits in front of training and generation.

  • Hard, high-stakes edge cases: Work on leakage paths, schema drift and adversarial failure modes, not only clean benchmark datasets.

  • San Francisco, Singapore, or remote: Work on-site in San Francisco or Singapore, or remotely, with hours that overlap about 70â80% with either US Pacific or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.

About us

At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Agentic AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn't just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too.

The role

Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer.

You will own Workflows and Integrations. That covers the workflow builder, templates, scheduling and run management, and the steps that workflows are built from. It also covers the platform's third-party connections outside media: digital asset management systems, file storage such as Google Drive, translation services, data services such as Foreplay, and more than a hundred other business tools. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients.

You will also own how workflows show up inside Scribble, our creative agent. Agents can already run as steps inside a workflow. The next step is for Scribble to find, build, change and run workflows on a person's behalf and report back as they run, and for a workflow to pause for a person's decision and act on it. You will work closely with the team that builds Scribble, and you will own the workflow experience it works through, so that a workflow behaves the same whether a person or an agent is driving it. When that works, building a workflow stops being a specialist job.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the charter for Workflows and Integrations: the durable problem, success metrics, and an explicit in and out scope list.

  • Grow adoption across every customer, measured by the number of workflows built and run and the number of people building them.

  • Make building a workflow simple enough for a marketer or creative to do without help, through templates, guided set-up and defaults that cover the common jobs.

  • Own the workflow experience that Scribble works through, so that an agent can find, build, change and run a workflow with the same tools a person uses.

  • Make human review part of the run: a workflow should pause for a person's decision, record it, and continue down the right path.

  • Make runs dependable at volume, with scheduling, run management, failure handling and clear status, so that a team trusts a workflow to run unattended.

  • Own third-party integrations outside media, from digital asset management and file storage to translation and data services, and make them built-in steps in a workflow, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them.

  • Set the integration framework and standards that client teams build on when they connect a system for a single client.

  • Work with customers to find the jobs they repeat every week and turn them into workflows and templates that others can reuse.

  • Run the full lifecycle from discovery to post-launch review, with a written hypothesis before every ship and a review against it afterwards.

  • Use product data and structured customer feedback to set priorities, working backwards from evidenced customer need.

  • Partner closely with design on the builder experience, and with engineering on run reliability and the integration framework. Partner with the PMs who own Scribble, agents and the editor, and with the client teams who build on your framework.

Your background

You will have three to five years of product management experience, and you want to own a key product and take it to the next level. You might be a great fit if you can walk us through:

  • A product you grew from a small group of power users to broad adoption, and what you changed to get there.

  • Shipping a builder, automation or workflow tool, and what you learned about making something powerful easy to start with.

  • Building integrations with third-party platforms or APIs: how you chose which to build, and how you kept them working.

About Sodalis

Specialty pharmacy is where the most complex and expensive drugs reach the most in-need patients, and it still runs on faxes, phone tag, and manual data entry. Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait.

Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist.

We're already in production, processing tens of thousands of prescriptions a week. Backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and founded by veterans of Apple's Applied ML, Included Health, and Avella Specialty Pharmacy (scaled to $1.5B+ before its acquisition by OptumRx).

Â 

The Opportunity

Everything we run today is cloud-based, and so are the pharmacy management systems we integrate with. But most of the specialty pharmacy market runs on-prem. To reach it, our system has to run on the pharmacy's systems instead of ours. Whether that's the full stack on-site or a hybrid split with our cloud is one of the first decisions you'd make. That's the problem you'd own.
We've never shipped an on-prem deployment, so there's no pattern to follow. You'll decide how our architecture gets packaged and deployed into environments we don't control, what has to change in our current infrastructure to make that possible, and how we maintain and see into those deployments once they're live.

We don't yet know what these environments look like in detail. Some pharmacies may have restricted outbound access, legacy hardware, or IT teams that can't give us a login; others may be more open. Part of the job is going in with our customer, finding out what's actually there, and designing something that works across the range.
You'll start with our AI pharmacy tech product, rolling out with a committed customer, so you build against a real deployment instead of a hypothetical one. You'd work directly with the founders and the early engineering team on the architecture.

What you'll do

  • Decide how our architecture runs in a pharmacy's environment, starting with the AI pharmacy tech product: full stack on-site, a hybrid split with our cloud, or something in between.

  • Adapt our current infrastructure and build the packaging and deployment path that installs and updates Sodalis at each pharmacy.

  • Own those deployments over time: upgrades, rollbacks, and observability into health and failures without being on site.

  • Go in with our customer and pharmacy IT teams to learn what their environments actually allow, and design for the range.

  • Partner with the founders and early engineering team on architecture.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in infrastructure or platform engineering.

  • You've taken an AWS-native stack and made it run on Kubernetes or similar in environments you don't operate, including stateful services.

  • You've shipped and maintained software running in environments you don't control: on-prem, customer-hosted, edge, or embedded.

  • You've kept a fleet of remote installs updated, observable, and recoverable without being able to log into them.

  • You've set the first pattern for something in a startup and are comfortable with ambiguity.

  • You'll spend time with pharmacy IT teams and need to understand their constraints firsthand. No healthcare background required.

How we work

We're a handful of people going all in on a problem we think is worth it, holding a high bar and shipping work that reaches real patients. It's intense, and it isn't for everyone. We want people who want to build something that matters, alongside others who care as much as they do. If that's you, we should talk.

The role
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. What you'll do

  • Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

  • Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

  • Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

  • Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

  • Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

  • Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

  • Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

  • Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for

  • Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

  • Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

  • AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

  • Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

  • Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

Dabei läuft bei uns alles über unser selbst entwickeltes Case-Management-System.

Software als Grundlage unserer Dienstleistung

So wie Software zum Service geworden ist (SaaS), entwickelt sich heute auch das Dienstleistungsgeschäft hin zu Software. Unsere Dienstleistung eignet sich dafür besonders gut: Wir bearbeiten sehr viele gleichartige Fälle nach klar definierten Abläufen, und Software sorgt dafür, dass dabei nichts liegen bleibt und nichts übersehen wird. Bei uns ist das nicht neu: Wir haben schon softwaregetrieben gearbeitet, bevor KI zum Thema wurde – und genau das ermöglicht unser solides Wachstum.

Unser Ansatz: Wir entwickeln mit KI-Agenten – was dabei entsteht, ist aber deterministische, nachvollziehbare Software. In unseren Arbeitsabläufen setzen wir KI nur ein, wenn es nötig ist; die rechtliche Einschätzung bleibt in juristischer Hand. Wer jetzt dazukommt, lernt das System von Grund auf kennen und baut es Schritt für Schritt mit aus.

Warum wir dich suchen

Unser Kanzleiinhaber Matthias Prinz hat selbst Wirtschaftsinformatik (B. Sc.) an der TU München studiert. Wir wissen also ziemlich genau, was zu tun ist – Ideen, Konzepte und ein gut gefülltes Backlog haben wir. Derzeit setzen wir drei bis fünf Verbesserungen pro Tag um. Mit einer Entwicklerin oder einem Entwickler in Vollzeit wollen wir die Umsetzungsgeschwindigkeit erhöhen – durchdacht, getestet und passend zur bestehenden Architektur. Die fachliche Richtung ist klar – die technisch saubere Umsetzung liegt bei dir. Kein Beratungsgeschäft, keine wechselnden Kundenprojekte: Du entwickelst für dein eigenes Team und siehst jeden Tag, wie deine Software die Arbeit erleichtert.

  • Betrieb & Qualität: Du sicherst deine Arbeit mit automatisierten Tests ab, behältst Logs und Schnittstellen im Blick und findest bei Störungen systematisch die Ursache. Pflege und Fehlerbehebung gehören genauso dazu wie neue Funktionen.

  • Schulung: Du stellst neue Funktionen im Team vor und schulst deine Kolleginnen und Kollegen im Umgang damit.

  • Erfahrung mit agentischer Softwareentwicklung (z. B. mit Claude Code) – für uns zentral: Du gibst KI-Agenten präzise Vorgaben, zerlegst Aufgaben in überschaubare Schritte und prüfst jedes Ergebnis kritisch

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Python, SQL (idealerweise Microsoft SQL Server), React/TypeScript und REST-APIs – aus dem Beruf, einer Werkstudententätigkeit oder eigenen Projekten

  • Von Vorteil: Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365 (Graph API, Entra ID), Docker, Git und CI/CD

About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

Senior Total Rewards Partner, Total Rewards

How you'll make impact

As Airwallex scales globally and prepares for its next stage of growth, you’ll own and evolve the Total Rewards agenda across compensation, benefits, job architecture, benchmarking, equity governance and pay transparency.

  • Own and evolve global compensation frameworks, salary structures, geographic differentials, market positioning, compensation cycles and financial models that support hiring, retention, executive decision-making and international expansion.

  • Build and improve job architecture and leveling frameworks that support organisational scalability, internal equity and talent mobility.

  • Shape regional and global benefits programmes, including plan design, annual renewals, broker and insurer negotiations, benchmarking and cost optimisation, while balancing employee value, fiscal discipline and local market requirements. Hands-on benefits administration isn’t the primary focus of this role.

  • Partner with executive leadership, People Partners and Talent Acquisition to turn complex reward data into clear recommendations, challenge decisions that conflict with business strategy, market data or regulatory requirements, and lead Total Rewards initiatives from scoping and design through implementation.

  • Support international market expansion by developing competitive, compliant and locally relevant compensation and benefits frameworks across global markets.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in Total Rewards, Compensation, or Benefits, ideally within high-growth technology or fintech environments.

  • Proven track record of designing, building, and scaling global compensation frameworks, benefits programs, and equity structures in hyper-growth organisations.

  • Strong expertise in compensation strategy, including market benchmarking, job and salary architecture, geographic pay differentials, compensation cycles, and financial modelling.

  • Experience designing benefits programs and leading annual renewals, including broker and insurer negotiations. Hands-on benefits administration is not a primary focus.

  • Practical experience managing compensation planning and equity programs, leading system implementations or migrations, and working with HR technology platforms such as Workday, BambooHR, Carta, Shareworks or Pave.

  • Advanced analytical capabilities, with the ability to translate complex data and financial models into actionable insights and executive recommendations.

  • Proven ability to influence and communicate Total Rewards decisions with senior leaders, People Partners, and Talent Acquisition, demonstrating sound business judgement and confidence in challenging decisions that conflict with business strategy, market data, or regulatory requirements.

  • A builder mindset, with the ability to operate independently, navigate ambiguity, and develop scalable solutions across global markets and time zones.

Preferred

  • Experience in a late-stage private, pre-IPO, or recently listed company, particularly navigating equity program transformation, strengthening rewards governance, and preparing for public-market readiness.

  • Experience building scalable Total Rewards programs from the ground up in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, with end-to-end ownership and strong accountability.

  • Experience advising C-suite and senior leadership stakeholders on compensation, benefits, equity and rewards governance.

  • Strong analytical and financial modelling skills, including scenario modelling and assessment of financial implications.

  • Experience partnering effectively across diverse cultures, functions and international teams, navigating time zones and varying local market requirements.

  • Experience translating complex compensation, benefits and equity concepts into clear, actionable messages for business leaders, People teams and employees.

You'll thrive here if

  • You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

  • You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

  • You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it.

  • You communicate clearly and directly across cultures, and you're thoughtful about how context shifts meaning across borders.

  • You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.

  • You're comfortable operating across time zones with a globally distributed team, including colleagues based in APAC and EMEA.

People and Talent is where the people infrastructure of a genuinely global company gets built. This is a team for the ambitious who want the resources and scope of a scaled business combined with the creative latitude of one still being shaped. If you want to influence how a truly global company hires, grows, and builds a talent dense organization, this is where people work becomes company-building work.

UNIK&CO recherche pour l’un de ses clients, acteur majeur du secteur Bancaire, un Opérateur Back-Office Cash Operations H/F pour une longue mission intérim de 12 mois.

– Connaissance des opérations bancaires : chèques, effet de commerce et virement/prélèvement.
– Vous avez de bonnes notions Word et Excel.
– Anglais professionnel, opérationnel, intermédiaire requis.
– Vous êtes rigoureux(se) et organisé(e).
– Flexibilité, disponibilité et esprit d’équipe sont vos principaux atouts.

About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

Lead and develop a team of four Account Managers responsible for retaining, supporting and expanding Airwallex’s French customer base. You’ll own the team’s post-sale operating model across onboarding, adoption, value realisation and expansion, while staying directly involved in strategic accounts, customer escalations, onboarding quality and growth opportunities.

  • Build practical playbooks, portfolio coverage models and operating cadences that improve customer outcomes, retention, adoption and expansion across payments, FX, cards, Spend, payouts and related products.

  • Improve visibility and predictability across onboarding progress, time-to-value, product adoption, customer health, expansion pipeline, GRR, NRR, satisfaction and retention.

  • Drive a repeatable, customer-led expansion motion based on validated customer needs, business triggers and demonstrated value.

  • Orchestrate complex level 2 customer issues with Support, KYC, Risk, Product and Operations, turning recurring friction into process improvements rather than repeated individual escalations.

  • Partner with Sales, Onboarding, Support, KYC, Risk, Product and Operations to improve customer outcomes and make Airwallex easier to adopt and grow in France.

Within the first 90 days, you’ll have mapped the portfolios, priority accounts, risks and expansion opportunities, established the team cadence and created visibility on the main customer and operational issues. Within six to twelve months, priority accounts should have clear plans and stakeholder coverage, the core playbooks should be consistently used, leading indicators should improve against an agreed baseline, and the four Account Managers should show stronger autonomy, commercial judgement and consistency.

You'll work from our Paris office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 5+ years in Account Management, Customer Success, Sales, Expansion or a related B2B commercial role.

  • 2+ years of direct people management experience, ideally leading a team of 3–8.

  • Proven ownership of retention, renewals, expansion, adoption, customer health or comparable outcomes.

  • Experience working with NRR, GRR, churn, expansion, adoption, time-to-value or customer satisfaction metrics.

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, payments, banking, FX, spend management, ERP or another complex operational environment.

  • Strong customer-facing experience with Finance, Operations, Treasury, Procurement, E-commerce, founders or senior executives.

  • Evidence of building or improving customer processes, playbooks, account segmentation, health reviews, handovers or escalation routines.

  • Ability to influence Support, KYC, Risk, Product and Operations without direct authority.

  • Fluent French and professional English.

  • Strong commercial judgement, ownership and comfort working in ambiguity.

Preferred

  • Experience in payments, fintech, banking, FX, cards, spend management or financial infrastructure.

  • Experience with KYC, AML, Risk, Compliance or regulated customer operations.

  • Experience managing strategic or multi-entity customers across France and international markets.

  • Experience in pre-sales, onboarding design or solution development.

  • Experience in Travel, E-commerce, SaaS, Technology or Professional Services.

You'll thrive here if

  • You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

  • You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You enjoy working closely with people across multiple countries and time zones as part of one connected, global team, including flexing your hours occasionally to make that connection work.

  • You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.

  • You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

Learn more about your team

SME & Growth at Airwallex is about more than closing deals. Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.   • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Contexte scientifique et missions :

 

Le développement de capteurs autonomes en énergie pour l'Internet des objets (IoT) représente un défi scientifique et technologique majeur. Dans ce contexte, les technologies de récupération d'énergie constituent des solutions prometteuses pour convertir différentes sources d'énergie présentes dans notre environnement (mécanique, thermique, solaire, électromagnétique, etc.) en énergie électrique.

Le projet européen THERMOHARV, réunissant l'Université de Mons, l'Université de Lille, le C2DE et l’IMT Nord Europe, ambitionne de développer une nouvelle génération de microgénérateurs thermoélectriques organiques (OTEG), flexibles et performants, capables de convertir directement la chaleur fatale en énergie électrique. Ces dispositifs pourraient notamment contribuer à l'alimentation de capteurs autonomes dans les bâtiments, les centres de données ou les environnements industriels.

Dans ce cadre, le Centre d'Enseignement, de Recherche et d'Innovation Matériaux & Procédés (CERI MP) d'IMT Nord Europe développe des encres fonctionnelles à base de nanotubes de carbone, présentant des propriétés thermoélectriques. Ces encres sont déposées sur des substrats polymères flexibles grâce à un procédé innovant de fabrication additive par écriture directe (Direct Ink Writing, DIW).

L'enjeu scientifique consiste à maîtriser les interactions entre la formulation des encres, leur imprimabilité et les performances thermoélectriques des dispositifs obtenus afin de concevoir des générateurs optimisés.

Dans ce contexte, les missions scientifiques et technologiques confiées à la personne recrutée seront les suivantes :

  1. Formulation des encres : développer et optimiser des encres thermoélectriques à base de nanotubes de carbone, notamment en étudiant l'influence des conditions de dispersion sur leurs propriétés.

  2. Caractérisation physicochimique : étudier les relations entre la formulation, l'état de dispersion des nanotubes de carbone et les propriétés rhéologiques des encres.

  3. Optimisation du procédé d'impression : identifier les paramètres d'écriture directe permettant d'obtenir des dépôts homogènes, reproductibles et présentant une géométrie maîtrisée.

  4. Conception et optimisation des dispositifs : modéliser l'influence de la géométrie des générateurs sur leurs performances thermoélectriques.

  5. Fabrication et caractérisation d'un prototype fonctionnel : concevoir, fabriquer et évaluer les performances d'un prototype de générateur thermoélectrique flexible.

 

Ce stage permettra ainsi de participer à l'ensemble de la chaîne de développement d'un dispositif fonctionnel, de la formulation des matériaux jusqu'à la validation expérimentale d'un prototype, au sein d'un environnement de recherche collaboratif.

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

About the Role

As a confirmed Radar Signal Processing Engineer on Harmattan AI's Radar team in Paris, you will own the signal processing algorithms behind our next-generation airborne radar payload. You will take full ownership of your workstream, from algorithmic research through embedded implementation and flight validation, working with high autonomy and minimal oversight. You will work closely with the EW and RF analytics teams to translate product-level requirements into deployed, mission-ready capabilities.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement near-real-time algorithms for radar image formation, including inverse SAR (ISAR) processing of moving targets.

  • Develop and refine detection and tracking algorithms (e.g., EKF/UKF-based approaches) for moving target indication on airborne radar data.

  • Contribute radar-derived observables and algorithms that support navigation when GNSS is unavailable.

  • Prototype and port algorithms onto the selected embedded computing platform, balancing algorithmic performance against real-time and resource constraints.

  • Validate algorithms end-to-end through hardware-in-the-loop bench testing, anechoic chamber campaigns, and real flight conditions, iterating quickly on results.

  • Work closely with the EW and RF analytics modules to align signal processing development with system-level requirements.

Candidate Requirements

  • 2 to 5 years of confirmed, hands-on experience in radar signal processing, gained in the defense or automotive radar industry preferably.

  • Solid experience in Signal Processing on radar systems, either FMCW or pulsed, is required; exposure to moving target tracking, ECCM, radar-based navigation, or live/real-time processing is a strong plus.

  • Strong theoretical foundations and genuine hands-on comfort with the underlying mathematics, not reliance on off-the-shelf tools or LLM-generated solutions.

  • A quick thinker, comfortable taking full ownership of a technical scope end-to-end with minimal oversight.

  • Comfortable working in a fast, iterative cycle: writing code, running hardware-in-the-loop tests, and pushing validated changes independently.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

Our platform brings together foundation-model machine learning, a scalable data generation engine, and a partnership track record exceeding $5B in collaborations across the world’s leading biopharma and tech organizations. We’ve recently closed an oversubscribed seed round partnering us with an elite group of sophisticated and dedicated VCs including DCVC, Nvidia’s Nventures, AIX, Yosemite among others.

Neo-1 is our all-atom foundation model that combines state-of-the-art structure prediction and molecular generation in a single system. Neo-1 enables rapid exploration of chemical and structural space for high value, previously intractable targets, and in particular unlocks small molecule proximity therapeutics like molecular glues with AI for the first time.

In parallel, we are developing an advanced structural interactomics platform built on proprietary XLMS technology and a lab equipped with next-generation mass spectrometry instrumentation. This platform produces proteome-scale maps of protein interactions and helps identify small molecules that modulate proximity. Together with Neo-1, it creates an integrated system capable of co-folding protein complexes while generating candidate small molecules to influence those interactions.

Proximity-based therapeutics represent one of most promising frontiers in modern drug discovery with the potential to treat previously intractable diseases and target ‘undruggable’ proteins. Our technology combines proteome-scale structural data with state-of-the-art generative AI foundation models, and coupled with our talented team of scientists and engineers we are uniquely well-positioned to discover and develop a new class of medicines. Come join us!

Hoe laat je een CRM, BPM, procesautomatisering, pensioenadministratie en maatwerk goed samenwerken? Hoe kunnen we AI en data concreet inzetten binnen het pensioendomein? Als onze IT Architect voor onze businessdomeinen vertaal je businessvragen naar concrete IT-oplossingen en praktisch advies. Je helpt teams en stakeholders om onderbouwde keuzes te maken over applicaties, platformen en integraties. Daarbij kijk je verder dan één systeem: je zorgt dat oplossingen werken in de praktijk én passen binnen de architectuur voor het pensioendomein. 

Wat je over ons moet weten?

Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en wij willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat.

Wat ga je doen?

Je werkt bij het Architecture team binnen de afdeling Digital Strategy, Architecture & Innovation. Samen met collega-architecten ben je verantwoordelijk voor de architectuur van het totale pensioendomein. Jullie verbinden de behoeften van de pensioenbusiness met de ontwikkeling van het IT-landschap en bewaken gezamenlijk de samenhang en richting binnen het domein. Je werkt nauw samen met business-, change- en platformteams en leveranciers om architectuurkeuzes te vertalen naar uitvoerbare oplossingen.

Als IT architect voor het pensioendomein ligt je zwaartepunt bij applicatie-, platform- en integratiearchitectuur. Je overziet de samenhang tussen klantbediening, pensioenprocessen, data en technologie en maakt concreet wat een verandering vraagt van de betrokken systemen. Je werkterrein omvat CRM, BPM, portalen, pensioenadministratie, gegevensuitwisseling, marketing technologie en maatwerkapplicaties. Je bent geen architect voor één platform, maar adviseert over oplossingen over de hele keten vanuit het perspectief van de businessbehoefte binnen de kaders van onze IT platformdiensten.

De exacte onderzoeksopdracht bepalen we samen, zodat deze aansluit bij jouw opleiding, interesses en afstudeereisen.

HG is een compacte, snelgroeiende en internationale organisatie waar je direct de impact van je werk ziet. Dit vraagt om eigenaarschap, initiatief en een pragmatische, resultaatgerichte houding. De cultuur is open en stimuleert het delen van ideeën, constructieve samenwerking en verantwoordelijkheid nemen. Alles wat we doen is gebaseerd op onze kernwaarden: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected.

Wat ga je doen?

Binnen HG zijn de eerste stappen in AI-adoptie al gezet. Er is dus een fundament om op voort te bouwen. Tijdens jouw stage help je ons om naar brede, structurele adoptie te gaan.

Concreet ga je onder andere:

  • Praktische en inspirerende Copilot-demo’s geven aan verschillende groepen medewerkers.

  • Bestaande adoptiedata analyseren en vertalen naar inzichten en concrete acties om gebruik en impact te vergroten.

  • Onderzoeken waar adoptie achterblijft en welke interventies kunnen helpen om medewerkers verder te brengen.

  • AI-trainingsprogramma’s ontwerpen en uitvoeren voor verschillende AI-maturiteitsniveaus, van collega’s die net beginnen tot ervaren gebruikers.

  • Trainingen, workshops, oefeningen en praktische hulpmiddelen ontwikkelen waarmee medewerkers AI direct in hun eigen werk kunnen toepassen.

  • De Copilot Academy op ons intranet verder ontwikkelen en actueel en relevant houden.

  • Medewerkers meenemen in de bredere AI-transformatie en concreet maken wat AI voor hun eigen werkzaamheden betekent.

  • Het AI Champions-programma ondersteunen en verder helpen ontwikkelen.

  • Feedback en behoeften van medewerkers ophalen en vertalen naar verbeteringen in trainingen, communicatie en andere adoptie-initiatieven.

  • Onderzoeken welke activiteiten daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan meer gebruik, betere AI-vaardigheden en waarde voor de organisatie.

Jouw onderzoek en werkzaamheden helpen HG om AI niet alleen beschikbaar te maken, maar daadwerkelijk onderdeel te maken van de dagelijkse manier van werken.

Je werkt rechtstreeks samen met onze AI Transformation Lead en hebt veel contact met collega’s uit verschillende afdelingen binnen de organisatie. Hierdoor krijg je een goed beeld van zowel de menselijke als bedrijfskundige kant van AI-transformatie.

Omdat HG actief is in meer dan 45 landen, werk je bovendien in een internationale omgeving waarin verschillende functies, perspectieven en niveaus van AI-volwassenheid samenkomen.

“We beginnen bij HG niet meer vanaf nul met AI. Er ligt een fundament en steeds meer collega’s werken ermee. De interessante vraag is nu: hoe zorgen we dat AI voor veel meer mensen écht onderdeel wordt van hun dagelijkse werk? Ik zoek iemand die het leuk vindt om daar samen met mij de volgende stap in te zetten.”
– Els Marchal, AI Transformation Lead


Wie ben je?

  • Je volgt een relevante hbo-opleiding, zoals Technische Bedrijfskunde, Business IT & Management, ICT, Business Informatics, Data & Business, Human Resource Management, Learning & Development, Communicatie of vergelijkbaar.

  • Je hebt interesse in AI én de manier waarop mensen nieuwe technologie adopteren.

  • Je vindt het leuk om voor groepen te staan en anderen iets nieuws te leren.

  • Je kunt complexe onderwerpen op een eenvoudige en praktische manier uitleggen.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig en gestructureerd.

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig en stelt kritische vragen.

  • Je vindt het interessant om data te analyseren en inzichten te vertalen naar concrete acties.

  • Je kunt goed schakelen tussen verschillende doelgroepen en niveaus van AI-ervaring.

  • Je vindt het leuk om trainingen, materialen en nieuwe manieren van leren te ontwikkelen.

  • Je durft initiatief te nemen en ideeën in de praktijk uit te proberen.

Ervaring met tools zoals Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT en Power BI is een pre. Belangrijker is dat je nieuwsgierig bent naar AI en enthousiast wordt van de vraag: hoe zorgen we ervoor dat mensen AI daadwerkelijk goed gaan gebruiken?

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een afstudeeropdracht met directe impact op de organisatie.

  • Intensieve begeleiding door de AI Transformation Lead.

  • Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en ondernemerschap.

  • De kans om ervaring op te doen met AI-adoptie en organisatieverandering.

  • Praktijkervaring met het ontwikkelen en geven van AI-trainingen, demo’s en workshops.

  • De mogelijkheid om met echte adoptiedata te werken en te onderzoeken welke interventies daadwerkelijk effect hebben.

  • Een actieve rol binnen het AI Champions-programma.

  • Werken aan actuele AI-vraagstukken binnen een internationale organisatie.

  • Een hybride werkomgeving vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Almere.

  • Een informele en betrokken werksfeer waarin samenwerking centraal staat.

  • Stagevergoeding van €450,- bruto per maand (obv 32 uur).

Aan het einde van je stage heb je niet alleen een sterke afstudeerscriptie, maar ook praktische ervaring opgedaan met AI-adoptie, training en organisatieverandering binnen een internationale organisatie. Je hebt zelf trainingen en demo’s gegeven, met echte adoptiedata gewerkt en gezien wat ervoor nodig is om medewerkers daadwerkelijk mee te krijgen in een AI-transformatie.

Wij zijn HG!

Bij HG, een toonaangevend Europees merk in specialistische reinigings- en onderhoudsproducten, geloven we dat een huis een plek moet zijn waar je zorgeloos kunt leven. Met aandacht voor de plek waar je woont en voor de spullen die je omringen. Daarom ontwikkelen wij onze producten zo dat ze veilig doen wat ze beloven.

De missie van HG is om jou te helpen optimaal van je huis te genieten, zonder je zorgen te maken over wat er mis kan gaan. Dit realiseren wij met onze zeer effectieve, veilige en specialistische reinigingsoplossingen, gecombineerd met deskundig advies.

Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Almere zetten wij ons dagelijks in voor superioriteit, innovatie, kwaliteit en klanttevredenheid. Met een sterke aanwezigheid in Europa en daarbuiten blijven wij continu investeren om een nog grotere impact te maken.

HG doet wat het belooft.
